title: How JavaScript runs (engines, parsing, and the event loop)
intro: JavaScript is not C# on a different syntax — it runs inside an engine on a single-threaded event loop. This module walks from what JavaScript is compared to C# and TypeScript, through V8's Just-In-Time (JIT) pipeline, execution contexts and the call stack, strict mode, the event loop, and how scripts and modules load in browser and Node.js hosts.

conceptCards.title: JavaScript vs C# / TypeScript
conceptCards.summary: JavaScript runs dynamically on V8 or another engine. TypeScript erases types before run time. C# compiles to IL with CLR metadata — different host, type system, and concurrency.
conceptCards.example: JSON.parse in Node returns a plain object; JsonSerializer.Deserialize in C# returns a typed CLR instance.

conceptCards.title: Engines and V8 JIT
conceptCards.summary: Parse → AST → Ignition bytecode → TurboFan for hot code → deoptimize on type or shape changes.
conceptCards.example: Warm up loops before benchmarking — first calls run in bytecode, not optimized machine code.

conceptCards.title: Execution context and call stack
conceptCards.summary: Call stack = who runs now (LIFO). Scope chain = lexical lookup. Closures keep outer environments after stack frames pop.
conceptCards.example: for (var i...) with setTimeout prints 3 three times; for (let j...) prints 0, 1, 2.

conceptCards.title: Strict vs sloppy mode
conceptCards.summary: Strict turns silent errors into throws: no implicit globals, undefined this in plain functions. ES modules are always strict.
conceptCards.example: accident = 1 creates a global in sloppy scripts; ReferenceError in strict mode or modules.

conceptCards.title: Event loop basics
conceptCards.summary: Single thread per realm. Sync code, then drain all microtasks (promises), then one macrotask (timers, I/O).
conceptCards.example: console.log order: 1, 4, 3, 2 for sync + setTimeout(0) + Promise.then puzzle.

conceptCards.title: Scripts and modules
conceptCards.summary: ES modules: strict, deferred, module scope, static import. Classic scripts: global var, sloppy default. Node: CJS vs ESM.
conceptCards.example: type=module scripts do not put top-level var on window; classic scripts do.
